result.title: CoDy: Codec Dynamics as Complementary Priors for Unsupervised Temporal Action Localization
result.summary: Unsupervised temporal action localization (UTAL) aims to identify action categories and localize their temporal boundaries without annotation supervision. Existing methods typically derive supervision for both tasks solely from RGB and optical-flow representations, often resulting in noisy category assignments and inaccurate temporal boundaries. In this work, we reveal an overlooked property of video codecs: group-of-pictures quantization patterns preserve category-discriminative dynamics, while motion-vector and residual variations exhibit pronounced responses around action transitions. Based on this insight, we propose CoDy, a codec dynamics-guided framework that exploits the codec as complementary information to the visual view for UTAL. CoDy integrates a codec-enhanced view with RGB and flow through confidence-aware consensus clustering, producing reliable soft pseudo-labels. It further converts codec dynamics into a class-agnostic boundary prior, which supervises visual boundary learning and guides proposal initialization and iterative refinement. The codec branches are only used during the training stage and introduce no extra codec-side computation at inference. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.3 demonstrate that CoDy consistently outperforms existing UTAL methods and achieves state-of-the-art localization performance. These results establish codec signals as effective annotation-free priors for jointly inferring which actions occur and when they occur.

AI.brief_summary: CoDy 面向无监督时序动作定位，把视频编码器的量化模式、运动矢量与残差变化当作互补先验：通过置信度感知的共识聚类融合 RGB／光流生成软伪标签，并将编码器动态转成类别无关的边界先验来监督边界学习与候选精修，编码器分支仅训练期使用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「训练期额外证据通道＋置信度共识伪标签＋类别无关状态切换先验」的结构，可能为 LVR 的监督信号构造与 STOP／状态切换判据提供可核查线索，但任务本身是视频动作定位，与 VLM 内部状态推理距离较远，迁移需自行验证。
